ClientResponses.Response:
Your feedback means a lot to us. We are very sorry to hear your grill is not getting hot. We are here to help. 

It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator. This safety device is a component of all LP gas regulators and is designed to reduce the flow of gas in the event of a leak.

You can inadvertently activate the safety device without having a gas leak. Typically, this occurs if you do not wait a sufficient time between opening the tank valve and the burner control knobs or if one or more of the burner control knobs is in an open position when opening the LP tank valve. When the safety device has been activated the grill is referred to as being in “bypass”.

Keep in mind that the safety device reacts to gas leaks. If a grill is in bypass, the gas connections and hose should be tested for leaks with a soap and water solution.

If you do activate the gas regulator safety device, the grill may struggle to reach high temperatures or may not light at all, even with all burners on the START/HIGH setting.

To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:

-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.

- Visually confirm all burners are extinguished (no flame present) 

-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.

-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.

-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.

-Close the grill lid.

-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.

When you are done grilling:

-Turn all burner control knobs to the OFF position

-Turn off the LP tank valve last.

Our Care team will be reaching out to assist you further. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: So happy I bought a Weber. Can’t say how it will last for the long term yet but I so miss grilling. My husband has been doing the grilling because the old grill was falling apart and didn’t do the auto ignition and I tend to blow things up. So I’m so very happy with the ease of use. Also very happy I can use a rotisserie. Have done it yet but it is installed, it rained the day I was going to. I would remind others to check their drain pan often as it does fill quickly and can cause a fire hazard, so order some extras. I kept forgetting to check my when it was cool until the dogs were trying to get at it, good thing the thing was almost over flowing. Now my biggest complaint I will lodge will be for my husband and it will be for building it, yes it takes a very long time!!! Afterwards he said we should have paid for for them to build it. Other thing to note it that it is sent by truck so it does not arrive quickly so just keep that in mind if ordering by phone or online. The delivery service in my area was wonderful. I was anxious to get mine so I called them and they told me the whole process and when I should expect for it to be delivered, even gave me the correct direct number for the hub that would deliver it. I had constant contact with the whole time until delivery. A+ Even uncreated and brought into my garage for me. Love Weber app the recipes there are great it is so nice that if I have questions about how to set my grill you have it there. Thumbs up. I have even bought some Weber cookbooks and some accessories. Looking forward to all of the things I can create. The only thing I feel like I am missing now is a side burner (which I never have had, nor missed before).  My husband is impressed with the amount of heat it puts out.
Results.Title: Extremely Happy w/my Spirit II E-310 gas propane
